description: One nuclide identity and versioned physical reference description, including stable daughters.

submitter_id.description: Stable submitter-assigned identifier, unique within a project. Do not encode direct patient identifiers.

term.description: A 128-bit identifier. Depending on the mechanism used to generate it, it is either guaranteed to be different from all other UUIDs/GUIDs generated until 3400 AD or extremely likely to be different. Its relatively small size lends itself well to sorting, ordering, and hashing of all sorts, storing in databases, simple allocation, and ease of programming in general.

model_version.description: Version of the submitting theranostics extension, independently of the MIDRC baseline version.

record_status.description: Record curation state, independent of clinical value.

source_record_id.description: Identifier of the originating source record; use an approved pseudonym when needed.

missing_properties.description: Names of properties missing from this record; no missing value is encoded as zero.

missing_reasons.description: Reasons corresponding by index to missing_properties.

name.description: Nuclide name, with element, mass number and nuclear state resolved.

atomic_number.description: Integer proton number Z; not an identifier code.

nuclear_state.description: Ground or specified metastable nuclear state.

is_stable.description: Whether the referenced nuclide is stable; a stable daughter has no finite physical half-life.

physical_half_life_seconds.description: Physical decay half-life in seconds, excluding biological elimination; positive for a radioactive nuclide.

half_life_uncertainty_seconds.description: Standard uncertainty of the physical half-life in seconds, if reported.

decay_constant_per_second.description: Decay constant in s^-1; derived as ln(2)/physical_half_life_seconds when that model applies.

reference_citation.description: Nuclear data source, release and locator supporting the physical properties.

reference_version.description: Version or evaluation date of the nuclear data source.
